Baseline data for passenger automobiles was readily available from the EPA, which has been preparing fuel economy data for those vehicles for several years. While the EPA was also able to supply baseline data for NPA's of 6,000 pounds and less GVWR, it could not do so for NPA's over 6,000 pounds GVWR. Moreover, the NHTSA did not have the time to develop its own data base for MY 1,979. Under the EPA regulation, Revised Light Duty Truck Regulations for 1979 and Later Model Year Vehicles, (40 FR 56316, December 28, 1976), that agency will be able to begin providing baseline data for most of these vehicles (up to 8,500 pounds GVWR) for MY 1979. Also, since the NHTSA is considering establishing standards for MY 1980 for NPA's above 6,000 pounds GVWR, it has initiated efforts to develop the necessary baseline data independently. However, NHTSA at this time does not have sufficient data to propose an AFES for MY 1979 for these NPA's.

Since the agency has little information on the fuel economy performance and fuel economy improvement potential of these vehicles, it is difficult to project the environmental impact of extending the AFES to these vehicles.
